_: scripts/reprint-check.mjs CHECK 6. Records whose source.book is not a book their own Archives document is printed in (under any spelling of it), as they stood when the check went in on 2026-09-25 — each "<record book> <= <the document's books>". Desk #166 (owner, 'Middle way'): different books are never folded together. A record NOT listed here that names another book fails the check; a listed record that has been repaired, or whose pair of books has changed, fails too — remove or correct its line, the list only shrinks. The largest group was the Foundry label 'Pathfinder Kingmaker' over the Kingmaker Adventure Path and the Kingmaker Companion Guide (a fold of two books). Package I (I7d, 2026-10-17) gave 114 of those records their own document's book through overlay rows, and src/rules/sources.ts BOOK_SPLITS keeps a saved selection from being narrowed by it. The two still listed (feats/roll-with-it-kingmaker, conditions/aon-concealed-army) are stamped on another printing's page (feat-1009, condition-62), so they leave with their aonId repoint in the regenerating lane. Package I's regen inputs (2026-10-18) gave both their own book (overlay `source` rows) and their own page (scripts/data/manual-joins.json, a key-exact join build-map.mjs reads); until the next npm run data stamps that page their lines read the new book over the old page, and after it they and feats/quick-recovery, feats/the-harder-they-fall (joined the same way) name their document's book: CHECK 6 then fails all four as "remove the entry".
